module_summary: dia.cpp is the generic dialog engine inherited from Open PS2 Loader: it lays out and draws a UIItem array (labels, buttons, int/bool/enum/string/colour rows), handles wrapping, scrolling, right-stick peek, Settings-shell L1/R1 paging, list keys and the footer hints, and runs the modal input loop diaExecuteDialog. diaeditors.cpp holds the modal value editors (on-screen keyboard with caret, numeric pad, colour selector) and diaitems.cpp the get/set accessors over a UIItem array. dia.h declares the UIItem model and API; dialogs.h is the enum of every dialog item id plus the extern dialog tables defined in dialogs.cpp. cfgtitle.cpp is the opt-in 'CFG Titles in game lists' cache: the IO thread reads each game's CFG Title, sanitises it as strict UTF-8 and swaps a per-source title table in under the GUI lock for menusys drawing and sorting.

reusable_helpers.name: CfgTitles::clean / cfgTitleClean
reusable_helpers.what: trims blanks and copies a string only if it is strict printable UTF-8, cutting on a character boundary

reusable_helpers.name: utf8Length
reusable_helpers.what: length of one strict UTF-8 sequence (rejects overlong, surrogates, >U+10FFFF, C1)

reusable_helpers.name: diaKeybNextChar / diaKeybPrevChar
reusable_helpers.what: step to the next/previous UTF-8 character start in a byte string

reusable_helpers.name: diaDrawBoldText
reusable_helpers.what: draws text twice offset by one display pixel/line for a CRT-readable bold

reusable_helpers.name: diaShowKeyb
reusable_helpers.what: modal on-screen keyboard with caret, masking and horizontal scroll

reusable_helpers.name: diaShowNumPad
reusable_helpers.what: modal numeric pad with sign toggle and range display

reusable_helpers.name: diaFindByID
reusable_helpers.what: linear lookup of a UIItem by id in a terminator-ended array

reusable_helpers.name: diaEnumText
reusable_helpers.what: bounds-checked text of a NULL-terminated enum list entry

findings.title: inMenu parameter of diaExecuteDialog/diaRenderUI is never read; guiScreenInMenu and ScreenManager::inMenu exist only to feed it
findings.problem: diaRenderUI (dia.cpp:628-836) never uses its inMenu argument and diaExecuteDialog only forwards it there (dia.cpp:1175). All ~40 diaExecuteDialog callers pass the constant 1; the two diaRenderUI callers pass guiScreenInMenu(), whose only callers are those two lines. ScreenManager::inMenu() is called only by guiScreenInMenu, and Handler::inMenu is read only by ScreenManager::inMenu.
findings.fix: Delete the inMenu parameter from diaExecuteDialog and diaRenderUI (and the 1 argument at every call), delete guiScreenInMenu and its prototype, ScreenManager::inMenu, and the Handler::inMenu field with its column in screenHandlers.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines removed plus one argument at ~42 call sites; a few dozen bytes of code and 2 bytes per screenHandlers entry (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dia.cpp:628-836: inMenu not referenced. Grep diaRenderUI(|diaExecuteDialog( over src include: guiwait.cpp:134, guimodal.cpp:141 (guiScreenInMenu()), every diaExecuteDialog call in guisettings/guigame/guifilemgr/gui/drivestatus passes 1. Grep guiScreenInMenu: guiscreens.cpp:101 def, guiint.h:17, guiwait.cpp:134, guimodal.cpp:141 only. Grep inMenu() / ScreenManager::inMenu: guiscreens.cpp:36 def, :103 only caller; field read only at guiscreens.cpp:38. No .github test greps for inMenu.

findings.title: 13 dialogs.h item ids are never used, including two declared 'unused placeholder' and a 'retired' reserved slot
findings.problem: UICFG_ENABLE_ANALOG_NAV, CFG_ETHMODE, CFG_ENABLEUDPBD, CFG_NETBOOTPROTOCOL, CFG_POPSTARTER_DEVICE, CHTCFG_CHEATCFG, GSMCFG_GSCONFIG, COMPAT_RETIRED_DOWNLOAD_DEFAULTS, SECURITY_PARENTAL_BUTTON, ADV_PREFIX_BUTTON, ADV_STORAGE_BUTTON, CFG_HDDOPLPART and PADCFG_PADEMU_CONFIG appear nowhere outside dialogs.h (one comment and one source-text test). The 'preserve IDs' reasoning does not hold: the auto run before COMPAT_DMA = 100 already reaches 242 (251 with RA), and before COMPAT_MODE_BASE = 250 reaches 277 with PADEMU, so the explicit values reserve nothing.
findings.fix: Delete the 13 enumerators and the comments that defend them (dialogs.h:73-74 notes, :278, :407 note, dialogs.cpp:494-495 sentence), and drop the test assertion that requires COMPAT_RETIRED_DOWNLOAD_DEFAULTS.
findings.benefit: ~16 source lines; no ELF change (enumerators emit no code) (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Python scan of every enumerator in dialogs.h:6-408 against all .c/.cpp/.h/.py/.inc/.S files under src include ee_core modules tests .github: these 13 have no hit outside dialogs.h except dialogs.cpp:495 (comment) and test_settings_back_keeps_edits.py:422. Grep for ## token pasting in src/ui: only guisettings.cpp:1706 (handler names, unrelated). Enum values computed per build (PADEMU x RA) with a script: NARGS_LOGO=242/251, max before COMPAT_MODE_BASE with PADEMU=277. INFERRED: ids are runtime-only UI tags (no persistence of item ids was searched for exhaustively).

findings.title: Dialog footer drawn by two identical branches, and the editors re-spell guiCancelKey/guiConfirmIcon/guiCancelIcon inline
findings.problem: In diaRenderUI the non-Settings branch (822-835) draws gSelectButton==KEY_CIRCLE ? CIRCLE : CROSS and the reverse, which is exactly guiConfirmIcon()/guiCancelIcon() that the Settings branch (793-821) already uses; the two branches differ only by the settingsShell L1/R1 indicator. diaeditors.cpp writes the guiCancelKey()/guiCancelIcon()/guiConfirmIcon() ternaries out by hand seven times.
findings.fix: Keep one footer block (hints/icons from guiConfirmIcon/guiCancelIcon) with the settingsShell indicator as the only conditional part; replace the inline ternaries in diaeditors.cpp with guiCancelKey(), guiConfirmIcon() and guiCancelIcon().
findings.benefit: ~13 lines removed in dia.cpp; editors become one-call expressions (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dia.cpp:792-835 and guimodal.cpp:192-210 (guiConfirmKey returns gSelectButton; guiCancelKey/guiConfirmIcon/guiCancelIcon are the same ternaries). guiAlignSubMenuHints only measures total width, so icon order {CIRCLE,CROSS} vs {confirm,cancel} gives the same layout (INFERRED from its arguments). diaeditors.cpp lines listed contain gSelectButton == KEY_CIRCLE ? ... ternaries.

findings.title: diaRenderItem re-implements diaItemHeight's height rules and the fixed-size percent arithmetic appears four times
findings.problem: diaItemHeight is documented as 'kept byte-for-byte in step with diaRenderItem's *h logic', i.e. the same rules (spacer 0, colour 17, wrapped lines, fixedHeight override) are written twice and must be kept in sync by hand. The 'negative = percent of screen' conversion is written out at 252, 286, 459-462 and 469-472.
findings.fix: In diaRenderItem set *h once at the end from diaItemHeight(item, spacingH, (lines - 1) * MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT) and drop its own height assignments and fixedHeight block; replace the four percent conversions with one small static function (e.g. diaFixedSize(value, screenDim)).
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed and one sync hazard gone; static functions, so code size roughly unchanged (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dia.cpp:262-291 (diaItemHeight and its comment) and 309-476 (diaRenderItem): same h rules at 315/345/381/441/467-475; fixed-size conversion at 252, 286, 459-462, 469-472. The invisible early return in diaRenderItem (312-313) matches diaItemHeight's 273-274. Risk Med because layout is touched.

findings.title: diaExecuteDialog: nine exits each restore pad settings through one-line wrappers, and L1/R1 and cancel handling are written twice
findings.problem: diaStoreScrollSpeed/diaRestoreScrollSpeed only forward to padStoreSettings/padRestoreSettings, and diaRestoreScrollSpeed is repeated before each of nine returns (the comment at 1320-1323 records a bug from missing one). The Settings-shell L1 and R1 blocks (1199-1209) repeat the list-dialog L1/R1 block (1213-1217), and the two cancel blocks (1281-1292) differ only in the value returned.
findings.fix: Leave the loop with a result variable and one exit that calls padRestoreSettings once; call padStoreSettings directly and delete the two wrappers; merge the L1/R1 checks into one (settingsShell || ui == diaListUI) test and the two cancels into one returning settingsShell ? DIA_RESULT_INDEX : UIID_BTN_CANCEL.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed; removes the class of 'forgot to restore on this exit' bugs (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep diaRestoreScrollSpeed: dia.cpp:1095 def + 9 calls (1200,1206,1214,1220,1282,1289,1304,1311,1324). Grep diaStoreScrollSpeed: def 1090, one call 1154. Read 1195-1327: settingsShell L1/R1 returns PREV/NEXT identically to the diaListUI branch; settingsShell cancel returns DIA_RESULT_INDEX, the next block UIID_BTN_CANCEL, both with the same restore and sfx except SFX_CANCEL in both.

findings.title: On-screen keyboard repeats insert, backspace, enter and mode-switch code; numpad repeats backspace
findings.problem: In diaShowKeyb the caret insert (memmove, store, mask update, len++, caret++) is written three times (351-359, 372-380, 407-415), backspace twice (362-368, 396-403), ENTER with free(mask_buffer) twice plus once more at the exit (383-386, 418-421, 438-439) and the mode switch twice through a selkeyb counter and KEYB_MODE (389-393, 423-428). diaShowNumPad's '<' key repeats its Square backspace.
findings.fix: Use two local lambdas (insert a char at the caret, delete before the caret) and leave the loop through one exit that frees mask_buffer; toggle the layout with keyb = (keyb == keyb0) ? keyb1 : keyb0 and delete selkeyb and KEYB_MODE; share the numpad backspace branch.
findings.benefit: ~30 lines removed (INFERRED from the cited ranges)
findings.evidence: Read diaeditors.cpp:128-442 and 457-566 in full; the cited blocks are textually identical apart from the inserted character (keyb[selchar] vs ' '). KEYB_MODE used only at 389 and 423 (Grep).

findings.title: Every guiDrawBGSettings caller writes the same plasma fallback (10 sites)
findings.problem: guiDrawBGSettings returns 0 when the theme has no SETTINGS_BG texture, and all ten callers respond with the same 'if (guiDrawBGSettings() == 0) guiDrawBGPlasma();'. No caller uses the return value for anything else.
findings.fix: Make guiDrawBGSettings draw the plasma itself when the texture is missing and return void; each call site becomes one line.
findings.benefit: ~9 lines removed; ten compare-and-branch sequences become one (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep guiDrawBGSettings( over the repo: definition guisettings.cpp:1936, prototype gui.h:143, and the ten call sites listed, each followed by guiDrawBGPlasma(); on the next line.

findings.title: Small duplications in dia.cpp: single-use diaGetLocalisedText, repeated enum clamp, duplicated string-commit branch
findings.problem: diaGetLocalisedText has one caller (diaLabelText). diaHandleInput re-counts and clamps the enum index (954-960) the way diaEnumText already does (186-197). The string editor has two identical commit blocks (942-943 and 947-948) that differ only in whether the handler or diaShowKeyb produced the text. 'int renderX = x;' is a pointless copy.
findings.fix: Inline diaGetLocalisedText into diaLabelText; share one 'enum count' helper between diaEnumText and diaHandleInput; choose the editor with one conditional expression and commit once; pass x directly.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines removed; no measurable size change (static functions) (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep diaGetLocalisedText: dia.cpp:49 def, :133 only use. Read 186-197, 935-972 and 694-700.

findings.title: diaLayoutBottom repeats diaRenderUI's whole row-layout walk
findings.problem: diaLayoutBottom walks the items 'exactly as diaRenderUI lays them out': the row-collapse, break-before/after, lead, spacer advance and hmax/y bookkeeping are the same statements in both loops (about 25 lines), so any layout change must be made twice.
findings.fix: Let diaRenderUI's pass use one shared walker (diaLayoutBottom with an optional draw step, or a per-item callback) so the bookkeeping exists once.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed and one sync hazard gone (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dia.cpp:566-610 and 650-728 side by side: collapse handling 576-581 vs 653-659, break handling 582-591 vs 660-672, lead update 595-596 vs 701-702, break-after 601-607 vs 717-725. Net reduction is an estimate (the merged walker needs a draw hook).

findings.title: CfgTitles has a free-function forwarding layer; cfgTitleForRow and cfgTitleClean are used only by a host test
findings.problem: Each public CfgTitles method is mirrored by a cfgTitle* wrapper over the single global gCfgTitles. Production uses only cfgTitleRefresh, cfgTitleForget (opl.cpp), cfgTitleDisplayName (menusys.cpp, host.cpp) and cfgTitleSortName (menusys.cpp); cfgTitleForRow and cfgTitleClean are called only inside cfgtitle.cpp and by .github/scripts/test_cfg_titles.py.
findings.fix: Delete the cfgTitleForRow and cfgTitleClean wrappers and their prototypes, call CfgTitles::clean directly at cfgtitle.cpp:230, and point the host test at gCfgTitles.forRow / CfgTitles::clean.
findings.benefit: ~4 lines removed; a smaller public surface (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep gCfgTitles|CfgTitles::|cfgTitle(Clean|Refresh|Forget|ForRow|DisplayName|SortName) over the repo: production callers opl.cpp:711,842, menusys.cpp:1801-1802,2967,3332, host.cpp:107; cfgTitleForRow/cfgTitleClean only at cfgtitle.cpp:230,269,272 and test_cfg_titles.py.

findings.title: Stale comments and leftovers in the dialog files
findings.problem: Comments name files that no longer exist (cfgtitle.c, dia.c, dialogs.c, gui.c); dia.cpp:1177 is a NOTE(rebuild) placeholder for a missing Debug-Colors HUD line; dia.cpp:1320-1323 narrates a past bug with a hard-coded '300 ms' that diaScrollDelay replaced; diaeditors.cpp ends with blank lines and an orphan separator comment.
findings.fix: Fix the file names, delete the NOTE(rebuild) line and the bug narrative (one short line is enough, or none after finding 5), and delete the trailing separator.
findings.evidence: Read the cited lines. Glob: no src/ui/cfgtitle.c, dia.c, dialogs.c or gui.c in the tree (sources are .cpp per ps2.yaml:641). diaScrollDelay at dia.cpp:1112-1124 gives 200-500 ms.
